story.titleZh: 美国大奖赛暴露法拉利短板
story.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔在美国大奖赛获得亚军后表示，未能夺冠令人遗憾；领队瓦塞尔承认，法拉利在排位赛第三节最后两圈丢失了时间。
story.originalTitle: What the US GP really exposed about where Ferrari is lacking
story.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc said it was a "shame" that Ferrari "came short of winning" after finishing runner-up at the United States Grand Prix, and team principal Fred Vasseur acknowledged the team lost time in the final two laps of Q3.
detailZh: 勒克莱尔在美国大奖赛获得亚军后的言论，完美概括了法拉利2026赛季F1征程的许多方面。
他说，"我们未能夺冠"令人"遗憾"。
奥斯汀站典型地体现了法拉利今年的一个反复出现的主题：练习赛全程强劲，排位赛早期有竞争力，Q3表现令人失望，正赛中追赶，但往往为时过晚，无法拿下胜利。
领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔并未否认这一评价。
他说：“我认为这个周末进展顺利，升级套件的一切都按预期工作。但问题在于，从FP1第一圈到正赛最后一圈，我们所有圈都跑得不错，唯独两辆车在Q3的最后两圈例外。那大概就是我们有所欠缺的地方。”
美国大奖赛不仅对法拉利，也对所有在前方竞争的车队凸显了一点：如果一切没有做到完美，排位赛中损失最小的时间也可能决定整个周末的成败。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在发车格上位列第四和第五，无论从最终名次还是对正赛希望的影响来看，这都令人失望。
然而汉密尔顿第五快的圈速，距离维斯塔潘用来让自己占据头排发车位的成绩，仅差0.097秒。
正如瓦塞尔所说：“我们不必下结论，因为我们是第五名，距离第一名只有0.3秒。这不算灾难。你可能是第五名，但距离第二名0.8秒。”
定义法拉利周末的差距，并非底盘/引擎组合缺少根本性的东西；而是在Q3等关键时刻未能充分挖掘其全部潜力。
而在不让千分之一秒溜走这件事上，并非所有因素都能控制，这也是法拉利并非唯一遇到的问题。
许多车手在美洲赛道Q3的第二轮尝试中都难以提升，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯认为他的赛车足够快，可以排到第二，但最终只排在第八位（部分原因是违反了赛道限制）。
瓦塞尔补充道：“确实如此，就赛车和轮胎而言，工作窗口非常狭窄。一旦你稍微偏离，很快就会损失两到三成。”
“如今在F1中，对于前八名来说，两到三成可能意味着六个名次的变化。这意味着，一阵风、出圈时稍微滑得太多，或者不得不减速过多并保持节奏，都可能让你从超级成绩跌至一无所有。”
众所周知，法拉利赛车的特性使其在排位赛中比其他车队更难让轮胎进入工作状态，因此勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在寻找理想工作温度甜区时总是困难得多。
如果像奥斯汀那样乌云密布、温度哪怕只下降几度，他们的头疼可能会加剧。勒克莱尔表示，这在Q3中的影响对他来说就像“白天与黑夜”的差别，甚至出圈的感觉都截然不同。
不过这不仅仅是轮胎的问题，因为汉密尔顿在美国大奖赛周末的调校选择上付出了代价。
他在第一节练习中未能迅速进入状态，在第二节练习中走错了方向，此后尽管到周六早上情况有所好转，但他一直在追赶，试图找到一个前部有足够抓地力的平衡。
而且在正赛前没有调整到位，前轮在早期阶段过度磨损，使他追赶勒克莱尔的希望破灭。
“我认为我们只是一直没有调到最佳，不知为何，持续地没有调到最佳，”汉密尔顿说。
他只有在比赛最后一节时，才把赛车的平衡调到了接近所需的状态，但那时已经太晚，做不了什么了。不过如下图所示，他与勒克莱尔的差距被大幅缩小了。
回顾整场比赛中不断加大前翼角度，汉密尔顿说：“在进站期间，我加了四格。下一次进站，又加了四格，即便如此，我还是差了四格。”
“这太疯狂了，差了12格。我们真的需要研究一下是怎么走到这一步的。”
他补充道：“我觉得如果我能拥有我需要的平衡，哪怕只是在最后一节有那个平衡，我本可以一直战斗到最后。”
勒克莱尔本人认为，他成功调校到赛车上的设定——以及他对转向敏锐赛车的容忍度是众所周知的——是他取得进步的关键。
“这些赛车非常特殊且独特，我觉得在过去两三场比赛中，我在驾驶方面再次解锁了一些东西，尤其是在调校与我的驾驶风格相匹配方面，”他说。
奥斯汀的教训——法拉利需要在正确的时间做好一切——来得正是时候，因为车队开始为明年的赛车确定概念选择。
而这正是汉密尔顿全神贯注确保将自己的意见纳入其中的事情。
他说：“我认为这是一个关键节点，可以借此把赛车引向明年正确的方向。”
“所以我正在着力处理我们明年赛车需要改进的领域，这是本周末以及接下来几个周末讨论的一部分。”
法拉利不需要一场革命，就能找到如今让第三排和前排产生差距的进步。
更多动力会有帮助，但众所周知，法拉利为此牺牲了一部分动力，以换取更好的底盘性能。然而，就像第三节排位赛中正在发生的情况一样，细节将决定一切。
汉密尔顿补充道：“现在正是你真正需要做出决定的时候，并且要明确这些就是那些区域——如果你为明年把这些地方修正好，每个弯角就能快半成。”
“这些就是我们正在挣扎的区域。这就是我明年想要的空气动力学平衡。但问题并不是特别多。”
“我认为我们有一套非常好的套件，所以要保留赛车上的优点，并纠正这几处细微的差别，然后再看看直线速度的情况。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc's comments after finishing runner-up in the United States Grand Prix perfectly sum up much of Ferrari's 2026 Formula 1 campaign.
He said it was a "shame" that "we came short of winning".

Austin typified a bit of a running theme for Ferrari this year. Strong throughout practice, in contention early on in qualifying, underwhelming in Q3, recovering in the race but often leaving it too late to take the victory.
It is an assessment that team principal Fred Vasseur did not dispute.

"I think the weekend went well and everything is working as expected on the [upgrade] package," he said. "But the issue is that we did all the laps, from the first lap of FP1 to the last lap of the race, in good shape except the last two laps of Q3 on both cars. It's probably where we missed something."

What the US GP highlighted for not just Ferrari but all those fighting at the front is that, if everything is not nailed perfectly, the consequences from losing the smallest amount of time in qualifying can define weekends.
Fourth and fifth on the grid for Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton was a disappointment in terms of the final positions and the impact that would then have on their hopes for the race.
Yet Hamilton's fifth-fastest time was just 0.097 seconds off what Max Verstappen had been able to deliver to put himself on the front row.
As Vasseur said: "We don't have to draw a conclusion because we are P5 and we are three tenths off P1. It’s not a disaster. You can be P5 and be eight tenths off P2."
The deficit that defined Ferrari's weekend is not about a chassis/engine package lacking something fundamental; it’s about extracting the full potential from it in critical moments such as Q3.
And when it comes to not letting thousandths slip away, not all the elements can be controlled, and it's a problem that Ferrari is not alone in experiencing.

A lot of drivers struggled to improve on their second Q3 runs at the Circuit of the Americas, and McLaren's Lando Norris reckoned he had a car quick enough for second but ended up eighth on the grid (held back partly by a track-limits breach).
Vasseur added: "What is true is that with the cars and the tyres, the window is very narrow. And as soon as you are a bit out, quickly you lose two or three tenths.

"Today in F1 for the top eight, two or three tenths can be six positions. It means that you can move from a super result to nowhere for a gust of wind, or you slide a little bit too much in the outlap, or you have to slow down a bit too much and stick to your pace."

It's well understood that Ferrari's car characteristics make it harder for it to fire up the tyres for qualifying than others, so Leclerc and Hamilton always have a much tougher time finding that ideal sweet spot with operating temperatures.

And their headaches can increase if, as happened at Austin, the clouds come over and the temperature drops even just a few degrees. Leclerc said the impact of this in Q3 was like a "night and day" difference for him in terms of how even the outlap felt.
It is not just about tyres though, because Hamilton paid the price for set-up choices made over the US weekend.

He had not hit the ground running in FP1, went in the wrong direction in FP2 and from then on, although things were better by Saturday morning, was in catch-up mode as he chased a balance that had enough on the nose.
And having not gone far enough before the race, the front washing out too much in the early stages put paid to his hopes of matching Leclerc.
"I think we've just been under-hitting it, continuously under-hit it, for some reason," said Hamilton.

He only got his car anywhere near where he needed the balance to be for the final stint of the race, by which stage it was too late to do anything. But as the graphic below shows, the deficit to Leclerc was slashed considerably.

Reflecting on adding more and more front wing throughout the race, Hamilton said: "Through the pitstops, I added four clicks. The next pitstop, added another four clicks, and even then, I'm still another four clicks too short.
"It's crazy, like to be 12 clicks down. We really need to look in how we are getting to that point."
He added: "I think if I had had the balance that I need, even if I just had the balance in the last stint, I would have been right in the fight all the way to the end."
Leclerc himself felt that a set-up he has managed to dial into the car - and his tolerance with a pointy car is well-known - has been the key to progress he has made.
"These cars are very specific and unique, and I feel like, over the last two or three races, I've unlocked something again in terms of driving, and particularly set-up with my driving," he said.
The lesson from Austin that Ferrari needs to nail everything at the right moment comes at an important time as it begins committing to its concept choices for next year's car.
And this is something that Hamilton is laser-focused on ensuring he feeds his opinion into.
"I see a pivotal moment in terms of steering the car in the right direction for next year," he said.
"So I'm really working on areas that we need to improve for next year's car, so that's part of the discussion this weekend, the next couple of weekends."
It does not need a revolution for Ferrari to find the progress that is the difference these days between the third row and the front.

More power will help, but it's known Ferrari sacrificed some of that for better chassis performance. However, like with what is happening in Q3, it's the details that are going to count for everything.

Hamilton added: "This is the time where you actually start to need to make decisions and actually fall in line that these are the areas that if you fix these for next year it's half a tenth in every corner.
"These are the areas that we're struggling with. This is where I want the aero balance to be for next year. But there's not a huge amount of things.
"I think we've got a really good package, so it's keeping on the good things of the car and rectifying a couple of these small, subtle differences, and then see about the straightline speed."
keyPointsZh: 法拉利本站练习赛表现强劲，排位赛早期有竞争力，但Q3表现不佳，正赛追赶但常常为时过晚。
瓦塞尔表示，升级套件一切按预期工作，问题出在排位赛第三节最后两圈。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari was strong throughout practice and in contention early in qualifying, but underwhelming in Q3 and recovered in the race, often too late to win.
Vasseur said the upgrade package worked as expected, with the issue being the final two laps of Q3.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
